shared_or_similar_visual_information: A fill selecting one side of a visible geometric or plotted boundary. On the left, use the gray half-plane to the right of the descending dashed line through the origin. On the right, use the light-blue patch inside the large semicircle and above both smaller arcs.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: It marks the open solution half-plane of a strict linear inequality. Right image: It comprises the large semicircle minus the two unshaded smaller semicircles.
Rationales: The shaded half-plane records which coordinate pairs meet an inequality. The geometric fill delimits a measured area after removing the depicted cutout or excluded portion.
